E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that they’re hosting pet clinics
on March 6 and March 27; and that the pickleball courts are open to residents Monday – Friday 9:00 AM
– 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM – 8:30 PM, and Saturday 9:00 AM – 2:30 PM.
